public_rationale: Marcus predicted on January 1, 2025, under the heading 'Medium confidence', that Sora would continue to have trouble with physics. When OpenAI launched Sora 2 on September 30, 2025, it said the model is 'still imperfect' at obeying the laws of physics, while better than prior systems.
limitations: The only evidence is OpenAI's own description. No independent test of Sora's physics in 2025 was read.
OpenAI also says Sora 2 is better about physics than prior systems. This record assesses whether trouble continued, not whether it shrank.
The evidence is dated 30 September 2025, not the end of the year.

our_interpretation: We read 'Sora' as the Sora models OpenAI offered during 2025, including Sora 2.
We read 'trouble with physics' as videos that break physical behaviour, such as objects that morph, teleport, or vanish, as described by OpenAI or by an independent test.

criteria.contradiction_condition: OpenAI's own description, or an independent test published in 2025, shows the Sora model then offered depicting physics without notable errors.
